# asherin

> asherin is a subscription AI workspace. two tiers: asherin at $18/month, and asherin pro at $79/month. monthly, in USD, no free trial. a team workspace is billed separately. enterprise pricing is on request.

what you get on a seat: chat, a library of saved material, projects, memory, guardian vault (encrypted storage), whiteboard, maps, connect, and a team workspace on pro. you can bring your own model key — gemini, openai, claude, mistral, xai, groq, deepseek, openrouter, venice — and pay that vendor directly, with no markup from us.

## honest limits

- asherin reads live sources and cites them. it does not always find one, and when it does not, it says so.
- forecasts are probabilistic, with a stated verification plan. they are not predictions of record.
- nothing here is legal, medical or financial advice.
- some modules are research surfaces, not sold products. those are labelled as such on the page.
